verdict.rationale: Insomnia's MCP support is client-side only (docs-30, docs-46) — it lets users discover and invoke external MCP servers' tools/prompts, and a brief mention of connecting to Konnect for 'protecting requests' (docs-14), but there is no evidence of built-in token-limit enforcement, prompt guards, or LLM provider routing/proxying within Insomnia itself. Missing for 10: any documentation of token/rate limiting, prompt injection guards, or multi-provider routing/proxy governance features.
